Title: Question for LSJ regarding merging titles and sects.

Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
Lambach (Sabbat Cardinal) merges
and becomes independant, titled vampire
with two votes (card text).

Into the fire is then played on him
making him sabbat.

What title does he end up with, and does the controlling
player choose if the answer is either?

-JTP

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 25 Nov 2004 09:38:12 +0100, "Reyda" <true_...@hotmail.com>
scrawled:



the reason behind that, for those who are interested, is that a
vampire may onlyhave one title, even if the other one would be
'dormant'.
so, as soon as you merge lambach, he loses his cardinal title when he
gains his 'two votes' title (and not because he is the wrong sect. if
he were _merely_ the wrong sect, he would still have his cardinal
title sitting there dormant). the 'two votes' title is not tied to his
sect, so when he becomes sabbat he still has the 'two votes'.
